draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.23, the 76th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 3rd of 20 at RB. He went 66th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (87th percentile), 10-yard split (81st percentile), bench press (84th percentile). College production: 905 rushing yards in 2023, 12th of 20 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals (reserve). 17 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 running back who played: 224 scrimmage yards against a median of 422, below the norm.
